description.value: Poets Cove Resort & Spa is a luxury Arts and Crafts-style oceanfront resort on South Pender Island in the Gulf Islands, offering 22 lodge rooms, 15 cottages, and 9 villas along the shores of Bedwell Harbour. The property includes a spa, marina, and three on-site restaurants ranging from fine West Coast dining at Aurora to casual pub fare at Syrens Bistro. Cyclists arriving by BC Ferries to Pender Island will find a full-service destination resort with accessible units and pet-friendly options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Poets Cove Resort & Spa is an actively operating luxury oceanfront resort on Pender Island with bookings, three restaurants, and varied accommodation types. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content. Syrens Bistro & Lounge is confirmed open daily for lunch and dinner, providing on-site evening food; Moorings Café is noted as 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON' but that is one outlet only.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the resort is located on Pender Island — these are distinct communities separated by ferry. May indicate a geocoding or community-assignment error in the OSM record.
Moorings Café is noted on the website as 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON'; the other two restaurants remain open.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating luxury resort on Pender Island with confirmed bookings and on-site dining; fully accessible to the public.
